47500.commentary: (MNa) posikā'ti divasassa dve tayo vāre nhāpetvā bhojetvā pāyetvā tumhe posesi.

examples.text: bah'ūpakārā, bhante, mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā khīrassa dāyikā, bhagavantaṃ janettiyā kālaṅ'katāya thaññaṃ pāyesi. bhagavā'pi, bhante, bah'ūpakāro mahāpajāpatiyā gotamiyā.

47501.meaning2: nourished, brought up, taken care of

examples.text: tasasi bhamasi leṇam'icchasi, attāṇo'si kuhiṃ gamissasi, app'ossukko bhuñja tuṇḍila, maṃs'atthāya hi posit'āmhase.
sūro'ti sūro vīro vikkanto abhīrū achambhī anutrāsī apalāyī. rājakhādāya puṭṭho'ti rājakhādanīyena rājabhojanīyena puṭṭho posito apādito vaḍḍhito'ti, sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho.

47503.commentary: (DNa) anto nimuggaposīnī'ti udakatalassa anto nimuggāni'y'eva hutvā posīni, vaḍḍhīnī'ti attho. (UDa) anaññaposino'ti āmisasaṅgaṇhanena aññe siss'ādike posetuṃ anussukkatāya anaññaposino. padadvayenassa kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena vicaraṇato sallahukavuttitaṃ subharataṃ paramañca santuṭṭhiṃ dasseti.

examples.text: udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udak'ānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni
piṇḍapātikassa bhikkhuno, attabharassa anaññaposino, devā pihayanti tādino, upasantassa sadā satīmato'ti.

47504.meaning1: should be supported; should be taken care of; should be looked after (by)
47504.meaning2: should be nourished, should be brought up, should be fed
47504.meaningLit: to cause to be taken care
47504.commentary: (NIDD1a) mātā me posetabbā'ti mātā mayā posetabbā. (MNt) iminā nayenā'ti dāsakammakarassa nivāsana-bhatta-vettan'ānuppadānena maṅgaladivasesu dhana-vatth'ālaṅ'kār'ānuppadān'ādinā ca posetabbo.

examples.text: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no mātāpitaro posetabbā, puttadāro posetabbo, dāsakammakarā posetabbā

47505.meaning2: nourishes, brings up, takes care of, feeds

examples.text: tam'enaṃ jātaṃ samānaṃ sakena lohitena poseti. lohitañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ mātuthaññaṃ.
putto ty'āhaṃ mahārāja, tvaṃ maṃ posa janādhipa, aññe'pi devo poseti, kiñ'ca devo sakaṃ pajan'ti.

47506.meaning1: to support; to look after; to takes care (of)
47506.meaning2: to nourish, to bring up, to take care of, to feed

examples.text: atthi kho, dhanañ'jāni, aññesaṃ hetukā dhammikā kamm'antā, yehi sakkā mātāpitaro c'eva posetuṃ, na ca pāpakammaṃ kātuṃ, puññañ'ca paṭipadaṃ paṭipajjituṃ.
idāni na sakkomi taṃ posetuṃ, imasmiṃ nagare kapaṇ'addhikādīnaṃ paṭiyattabhattāni atthi, tattha bhikkhāya caritvā jīvāhī'ti taṃ vissajjesi

47507.meaning2: having nourished, having brought up, having took care of, having fed

47508.meaning1: supporting; looking after; taking care (of); nurturing
47508.meaning2: nourishing, bringing up, taking care of, feeding

examples.text: naṅgalehi kasaṃ khettaṃ, bījāni pavapaṃ chamā, puttadārāni posentā, dhanaṃ vindanti māṇavā.

47509.meaning2: nourished, brought up, took care of, fed
47509.commentary: (DNa) āpādeyyan'ti nipphādeyyaṃ, āyuṃ vā pāpuṇāpeyyaṃ. poseyyan'ti bhojan'ādīhi bhareyyaṃ. vaḍḍheyyan'ti vaḍḍhiṃ gameyyaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho so aggiko jaṭilo taṃ dārakaṃ assamaṃ netvā āpādesi posesi vaḍḍhesi.
atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.

47510.meaning1: (gram) ppa; (unattested) conjugational sign of group 6 gahādigaṇa

examples.text: 489, 519. gahassa ghe ppe.

47511.meaning1: (gram) ppa suffix; (unattested) conjugational sign of group 6 gahādigaṇa

examples.text: gaha'icc'etassa dhātussa sabbassa ghekāro hoti ppapaccaye pare. gheppati.

47512.commentary: (SaDM) tathā plavati na sīdatī'ti plavo, nāvā eva. bhinnaplavo sāgarasse'va majjhe'ti hi jātakapāḷi dissati. (APt) plavati, plavanti anenā'ti vā plavo, plava gamane, gamanaṃ atra jalagamanaṃ.

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ niccaṃ bhavitabbaṃ brahmadatta, khemaṃ subhikkhaṃ sukhatā ca kāye, atth'accaye mā ahu sampamūḷho, bhinnaplavo sāgarasse'va majjhe.
manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.

47515.commentary: (ANa) dhammapadā plavantī'ti antarābhave nibbattamuṭṭhassatino, ye'pi pubbe sajjhāyamūlikā vācāparicita-buddhavacana-dhammā, te sabbe pasanne ādāse chāyā viya plavanti, pākaṭā hutvā paññāyanti.

examples.text: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati. tassa tattha sukhino dhammapadā plavanti. dandho, bhikkhave, sat'uppādo, atha so satto khippaṃ'y'eva visesagāmī hoti.

47521.meaning2: having floated, having moved quickly, having swum

examples.text: suddhassa ve sadā phaggu, suddhass'uposatho sadā, suddhassa sucikammassa, sadā sampajjate vataṃ.

47523.meaning1: name of a lunar month; February-March
47523.meaning2: month of the lunar calendar; February - March

examples.text: idāni pana cirena āgamissatī'ti maññamānā ādāya pakkamiṃsu. antar'aṭṭhakāsū'ti māghassa ca phagguṇassa ca antarā aṭṭhasu. na bhagavantaṃ sītaṃ ahosī'ti bhagavato sītaṃ n'āhosi.
atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mama vacanena moḷiyaphaggunaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi, satthā taṃ, āvuso phagguna, āmantetī'ti.

47527.meaning1: name of a lunar month; February-March

examples.text: so pana vassāno utu sāvaṇapoṭṭhapādamāsā, assayujakattikamāsā sarado, māgasiraphussamāsā hemanto, māghaphaggunamāsā sisiro, cittavesākhamāsā vasanto, jeṭṭh'āsaḷhamāsā gimho utū'ti veditabbo.

47530.commentary: (VINa) phaṇahatthako'ti yassa vaggulipakkhakā viya aṅguliyo sambaddhā honti, etaṃ pabbājetu'kāmena aṅgul'antarikāyo phāletvā sabbaṃ antaracammaṃ apanetvā phāsukaṃ katvā pabbājetabbo.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū phaṇahatthakaṃ pabbājenti.

47531.meaning2: instrument shaped like a snake hood, used for smoothing hair, etc.

examples.text: aggabījaṃ nāma, ajjukaṃ, phaṇijjakaṃ, hiriveraṃ, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi agge jāyanti, agge sañjāyanti, etaṃ aggabījaṃ nāma.

47534.synonym: kampati, pariphandati, pavedhati, byathati, vikampati, vedhati, vedhatī, saṅkampati, sampakampati, sampavedhati, saṃkampati

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ṭhite majjh'anhike kāle marīcikā phandati.
phandanaṃ capalaṃ cittaṃ, dūrakkhaṃ dunnivārayaṃ, ujuṃ karoti medhāvī, usukāro'va tejanaṃ.

47537.meaning1: Ujjain desmodium tree; sandan; Ougeinia oojeinense

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sālo vā dhavo vā phandano vā tīhi māluvālatāhi uddhasto pariyonaddho anayaṃ āpajjati, byasanaṃ āpajjati, anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.

47540.commentary: (MNa) phandato phandāpayato'ti paraṃ phandantaṃ phandanakāle sayam'pi phandato param'pi phandāpayato.

examples.text: santi, gahapatayo, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, karoto kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato, socayato socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato… karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.
mamāyite passatha phandamāne, macche'va app'odake khīṇasote, etam'pi disvā amamo careyya, bhavesu āsattim'akubbamāno.
phandamānaṃ pajaṃ disvā, macche app'odake yathā, aññam'aññehi byāruddhe, disvā maṃ bhayam'āvisi.

47542.grammar: prp of caus of √phand, caus, trans (+acc)
47542.meaning1: causing to intimidate; causing (others) to threaten
47542.commentary: (MNa) phandato phandāpayato'ti paraṃ phandantaṃ phandanakāle sayam'pi phandato param'pi phandāpayato.

examples.text: santi, gahapatayo, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, karoto kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato, socayato socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato… karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.

47543.commentary: (VINa) phandāpetī'ti ettha yāva ek'ābaddhaṃ katvā attano bhājanaṃ paveseti, tāva phandāpetī'ti vuccati. (VVt) phandāpetī'ti theyyacittena gaṇhitukāmatāya cāleti.

examples.text: phanditaṃ, bhikkhave, rogo, phanditaṃ gaṇḍo, phanditaṃ sallaṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, aphandamānena cetasā viharissāmā'ti, evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

47547.commentary: (MNa) aññatra phanditamattā'ti paccattharaṇe valisamphassena vā maṅguladaṭṭhena vā kāyaphandanamattaṃ nāma hoti. taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ kāyena karaṇakammaṃ nāma n'atthi. tam'pi ca kilesasahagatacitten'eva hoti.

examples.text: daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāyo'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pana kāyena pāpakammaṃ karissati, aññatra phanditamattā! daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa vācā'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ vācaṃ bhāsissati, aññatra roditamattā!

47548.commentary: (SNa) iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vā'ti ubhayen'api calanam'eva kathitaṃ.

examples.text: passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etassa bhikkhuno kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vā'ti? yadā'pi mayaṃ, bhante, taṃ āyasmantaṃ passāma saṅghamajjhe vā nisinnaṃ ekaṃ vā raho nisinnaṃ, tadā'pi mayaṃ tassa āyasmato na passāma kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vā'ti.

47549.commentary: (MNa) aññatra phanditamattā'ti paccattharaṇe valisamphassena vā maṅguladaṭṭhena vā kāyaphandanamattaṃ nāma hoti. taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ kāyena karaṇakammaṃ nāma n'atthi. tam'pi ca kilesasahagatacitten'eva hoti.

examples.text: daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāyo'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pana kāyena pāpakammaṃ karissati, aññatra phanditamattā! daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa vācā'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ vācaṃ bhāsissati, aññatra roditamattā!

47550.meaning2: having trembled, having throbbed, having stirred

examples.text: tato paraṃ, pañcah'ākārehi anodhisopharaṇā sattah'ākārehi odhisopharaṇā dasah'ākārehi disāpharaṇā'ti ayaṃ vikubbanā, sukhaṃ supatī'tiādayo ānisaṃsā ca mettāyaṃ vuttanayen'eva veditabbā'ti.

47556.meaning1: pervades; suffuses; fills; extends (to somebody with something)

examples.text: na hi nūna so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari. sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya.
kathañ'ca bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati? seyyathā'pi nāma ekaṃ puggalaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ disvā karuṇāyeyya, evam'eva sabbasatte karuṇāya pharatī'ti

47557.commentary: (ANa) n'eva gāme kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharatī'ti kūṭagopānasi-thambhasopān'ādīnaṃ atthāya anupaneyyatāya gāme na kaṭṭh'atthaṃ sādheti, khettakuṭipādaṃ vā mañcapādaṃ vā kātuṃ anupaneyyatāya na araññe kaṭṭh'atthaṃ sādheti. dvīsu koṭīsu gayhamānaṃ hatthaṃ ḍahati, majjhe gayhamānaṃ gūthena makkheti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, chav'ālātaṃ ubhatopadittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ, n'eva gāme kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati, n'āraññe kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati.

47558.meaning1: stretches out; draws out; goes on; extends (by)
47558.commentary: (MNa) dīghāpi kho te esā'ti udāyi esā tava vācā dīghā'pi bhaveyya, evaṃ vadantassa vassasatam'pi vassasahassam'pi pavatteyya, na ca atthaṃ dīpeyyā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: dīghā'pi kho te esā, udāyi, phareyya, yasmā, bhante, vaṇṇā añño vaṇṇo uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā n'atthi so paramo vaṇṇo'ti vadesi, tañ'ca vaṇṇaṃ na paññapesi.
anamataggo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro. pubbā koṭi nappaññāyati sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ

idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheri-paṇava-saṅkha-tiṇava-ninnāda-saddānaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo khantā hoti.

na hi nūna so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari. sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya.

47564.meaning1: to pervade; to suffuse; to fill

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena pharituṃ attaguttiyā attarakkhāya attaparittāyā'ti.

47565.meaning1: having suffused; having pervaded; having filled
47565.meaning2: having pervaded, having suffused, having filled

examples.text: so imam'eva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti
so mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ.

47566.meaning2: having pervaded, having suffused, having filled

examples.text: evam'ass'āyaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo dussamatto samādinno, ek'aṃsaṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati, riñcati kusalaṃ ṭhānaṃ.

47567.meaning1: having filled; having suffused; having pervaded
47567.meaning2: having filled; having suffused; having pervaded

examples.text: pītisukhena vipulena, pharitvāna samussayaṃ, lūkham'pi abhisambhonto, viharissāmi kānane.
m'āvoca pharusaṃ kañci, vuttā paṭivadeyyu taṃ, dukkhā hi sārambhakathā, paṭidaṇḍā phuseyyu taṃ.
sutvā rusito bahuṃ vācaṃ, samaṇānaṃ vā puthujanānaṃ, pharusena ne na paṭivajjā, na hi santo paṭisenikaronti.
vedanaṃ pharusaṃ jāniṃ, sarīrassa ca bhedanaṃ, garukaṃ vā'pi ābādhaṃ, cittakkhepañ'ca pāpuṇe.
ko ayaṃ muṇḍako chinnabhinnapaṭadharo'ti-ādīhi pharusavacanehi theraṃ santajjesi. etha gaṇhatha hanatha niddhamatha imaṃ samaṇanti nāgabalaṃ āṇāpesi.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso pāṇ'ātipātī adinn'ādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.
pare pharusavācā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha pharusāya vācāya paṭiviratā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

47572.meaning1: harsh words; rough language; unkind speech
47572.commentary: (SNa) yāya pana attānam'pi param'pi pharusaṃ karoti, yā vācā sayam'pi pharusā, n'eva kaṇṇasukhā na hadayaṅ'gamā, ayaṃ pharusavācā.

examples.text: pharusavācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti

47573.meaning1: dependent on harsh speech; due to unkind speech

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena pharusavāco hoti, pharusavācāpaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti

47576.meaning1: who speaks harshly; who uses rough language
47576.meaning2: who speaks harshly; who uses rough language

examples.text: āgamissanti kho bhoto yaññaṃ pharusavācino'pi pharusāya vācāya paṭiviratā'pi
pañcavassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu dve dhammā vepullam'agamaṃsu, pharusāvācā samphappalāpo ca. dvīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu'pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo'pi parihāyi.

47578.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of pharusa
47578.commentary: (ANa) patodavijjhana-kas'ābhighāta-pharusavacanehi ca damento pharusena dameti nāma (ANa) dahara-mahallaka-paris'āvacaraka-paṃsukūlika-dhammakathika-patirūpaṃ tava idan'ti vadanto pharusena vadati nāma.

examples.text: ahaṃ kho, bhante, assadammaṃ saṇhena'pi vinemi, pharusena'pi vinemi, saṇhapharusena'pi vinemī'ti.

pañc'ime, bhikkhave, vacanapathā yehi vo pare vadamānā vadeyyuṃ, kālena vā akālena vā, bhūtena vā abhūtena vā, saṇhena vā pharusena vā, atthasaṃhitena vā anatthasaṃhitena vā, mettacittā vā dos'antarā vā.

47579.commentary: (VINa) phalan'ti ambaphala-tālaphal'ādikaṃ yaṃkiñci, taṃ rukkhato gaṇhantassa vinicchayo rukkhe laggitakathāyaṃ vutto. apanetvā ṭhapitaṃ bhūmaṭṭh'ādi-saṅgahitam'eva.

examples.text: tattha jātakaṃ mūlaṃ vā tacaṃ vā pattaṃ vā pupphaṃ vā phalaṃ vā pañcamāsakaṃ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṃ vā agghanakaṃ theyyacitto āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. phandāpeti, āpatti thull'accayassa.
ekanavutito kappe, yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā, duggatiṃ n'ābhijānāmi, phaladānassidaṃ phalaṃ.
sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhaṃ atthi hutaṃ atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko atthi ayaṃ loko atthi paro loko atthi mātā atthi pitā atthi sattā opapātikā
appañ'hi etaṃ na alaṃ samāya, duve vivādassa phalāni brūmi, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, satti tiṇhaphalā. atha puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imaṃ sattiṃ tiṇhaphalaṃ pāṇinā vā muṭṭhinā vā paṭileṇissāmi paṭikoṭṭissāmi paṭivaṭṭessāmī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso loṇaphalaṃ paritte udakamallake pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu taṃ parittaṃ udakaṃ amunā loṇaphalena loṇaṃ assa apeyyan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.
ahu kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ ānakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkharaphalakaṃ antaradhāyi, āṇisaṅghāṭo'va avasissi.

47584.meaning1: strip of wood; bark strip; wood chip

examples.text: añño aṭṭh'aṅgulabahalaṃ udumbarapadaraṃ, caturaṅgulabahalaṃ asanapadaraṃ vinivijjhati, so pana phalakasatam'pi ekato baddhaṃ vinivijjhati, tathā dv'aṅgulabahalaṃ tambalohapaṭṭaṃ, aṅgulabahalaṃ ayapaṭṭaṃ.

maggena hi sattā kilesabandhanato nimuccanti, tasmā maggo sattānaṃ nimokkho'ti vutto. phalakkhaṇe pana te kilesabandhanato pamuttā, tasmā phalaṃ sattānaṃ pamokkho'ti vuttaṃ. nibbānaṃ patvā sattānaṃ sabbadukkhaṃ viviccati, tasmā nibbānaṃ viveko'ti vuttaṃ.
obhāsajātaṃ phalagaṃ, cittaṃ yassa abhiṇhaso, tādisaṃ bhikkhum'āsajja, kaṇha dukkhaṃ nigacchasī'ti.
upako phalagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo, bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bāhuraggi ca saṅgiyo, te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.
santi, bhikkhave, pupphagandhe adhivatthā devā. santi, bhikkhave, phalagandhe adhivatthā devā. santi, bhikkhave, rasagandhe adhivatthā devā.
atha puriso āgaccheyya phal'atthiko phalagavesī phalapariyesanaṃ caramāno. so taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā taṃ rukkhaṃ passeyya sampannaphalañ'ca upapannaphalañ'ca.

sattadhā me phale muddhā, jīvanto na sukhaṃ labhe, buddhagāth'ābhigīto'mhi, no ce muñceyya candiman'ti.
yathā pupph'ūpaga-phal'ūpaga-rukkhā samaye pupphanti c'eva phalanti ca, tath'eva tvam'pi taṃ samayaṃ anatikkamitvā khippaṃ sambodhim'uttamaṃ phusassū'ti-ādīni thutimaṅgalāni payirudāhaṃsu.
